description_expanded: ABOUT PURA VIDA Welcome to Pura Vida - your charming coastal escape located along the desirable East End of Panama City Beach, Florida. This beautifully appointed 5-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom private home comfortably sleeps up to 11 guests, offering the perfect blend of relaxation, comfort, and proximity to the beach. Just a quick 5-minute walk to the sugar-white sands between Beach Access #8 and #9, Pura Vida features a private pool, Gulf views, a fenced backyard, and multiple outdoor spaces designed for easy vacation living. Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, Smart TVs, WiFi, 10 provided beach towels, and ample gathering space throughout the home. Each bedroom offers cozy retreats, ensuring everyone has their space to relax, while the bathrooms are designed with convenience in mind, featuring modern fixtures and plenty of room. A bonus bunk room provides a flexible retreat for kids or extra guests. Whether you're unwinding on the balcony, strolling to Schooners for dinner, or soaking up the sun by your own private pool, Pura Vida is designed to help you slow down, breathe deeply, and savor the simple joys of beach life. With five designated parking spots, Gulf views, and thoughtful amenities throughout, your unforgettable Panama City Beach getaway begins at Pura Vida. Book your stay today and indulge in the charm and luxury of this fantastic property! ABOUT THE AREA Pura Vida sits in the peaceful East End of Panama City Beach near Thomas Drive - a location beloved for its relaxed beach vibe, walkability, and stunning Gulf views. With beach access just a few minutes away, it's effortless to spend your days swimming, shell hunting, or watching breathtaking sunsets. Nearby attractions within 5-10 min. to include: * Schooners (walkable) * St. Andrews State Park * Local Fishing Charters * Paddleboard + Kayak Rentals * Dolphin Tours * Mini Golf, Go-karts, Ripley's, Wonder Works and Family Fun Centers * Dining + Shopping on Thomas Drive *Many restaurants and bars like Captain Anderson's Restaurant (Popular local restaurant) Experience the perfect mix of laid-back beach days and local adventure - all from your home base at Pura Vida. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Gulf Views * Less Than 5-Minute Walk to the Beach (Access #8 & #9) * Private Pool * Fully Equipped Kitchen * Smart TVs & WiFi * Fenced Backyard * Outdoor Charcoal Grill * Bonus Bunk Room PARKING: * 5 Designated Parking Spots PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hours of booking or subject to cancellation * Must be 25 years or older to book * Smoking not permitted * All reservations are non-refundable - we strongly encourage purchasing travel insurance to protect your trip ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first-class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained to the highest standard. Our team is local and available 24/7 to ensure your stay is seamless and stress-free. Our mission is to help you create lasting memories, one beach vacation at a time.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
